gloss: without hesitation; freely; one after another

definitions.gloss: without hesitation; freely; go ahead and ~
definitions.explanation: Encourages someone to do something boldly and without holding back. Often used in invitations to submit, apply, or contact freely. Common in announcements and customer-facing text.

definitions.gloss: one after another; in rapid succession; thumping (footsteps)
definitions.explanation: Describes things happening or arriving one after another in quick succession, or originally the heavy thumping sound of footsteps. The 'in succession' meaning is the more common modern use.

examples.japanese: ご{意見|いけん}をどしどしお{寄|よ}せください。
examples.english: Please send us your opinions freely.

examples.japanese: {質問|しつもん}があればどしどし{聞|き}いてください。
examples.english: If you have questions, go ahead and ask without hesitation.

examples.japanese: {応募|おうぼ}{方法|ほうほう}は{下記|かき}の{通|とお}りです。{皆様|みなさま}どしどしご{応募|おうぼ}ください。
examples.english: Application instructions are as follows. We welcome applications from everyone, so please apply freely.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}がどしどし{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: Orders kept coming in one after another.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{足音|あしおと}がどしどしと{近|ちか}づいてきた。
セールが{始|はじ}まると、{客|きゃく}がどしどし{店内|てんない}に{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: When the sale started, customers came pouring into the store one after another.

notes:
An onomatopoeic adverb. Often used with or without と. Especially common in sense 1 as a friendly invitation to act without holding back.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どしどしお{送|おく}りください: please send freely
- どしどしご{応募|おうぼ}ください: please apply without hesitation
- どしどし{進|すす}める: to push ahead briskly
- どしどし{売|う}れる: to sell briskly (one after another)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どんどん: rapidly; briskly — overlapping meaning; どんどん is more general, どしどし has a heavier, weightier feel
- ばんばん: vigorously, energetically — emphasizes vigor; more colloquial
